title: Rezoning map change for 158-06 Northern Boulevard, Queens
summary: This resolution approves a zoning map amendment changing R5B/C1-2 and R2 districts to R7A/C2-4 and R7A at 158-06 Northern Boulevard in Murray Hill, Queens. It would facilitate a new 10-story mixed-use building with about 70,765 square feet of floor area and 76 apartments, including 19 income-restricted units. The Council held a public hearing on August 12, 2026 before approving the change with modifications.
